title: Chapter 397
text:
After obtaining the compression technology, the depth and breadth of the Mechanic class's combat power had increased at the same time. They had the ability to instantly take the initiative or turn the situation around. The speed of setting up the battlefield had a huge impact on the final outcome of the battle.

In the version after the rise of the Mechanic class, the other Supers would basically rush forward and stop the Mechanic from setting up the battlefield. If the Mechanic class was allowed to set up the weapons, the situation would be irreversible, and they would slide into the abyss of failure. Of course, this was the normal situation. Some special abilities or items would not be considered for the time being.

From the perspective of the battle rhythm, the Mechanic class naturally had the rhythm, forcing the enemy to have no choice but to deal with it. This was a huge advantage. Furthermore, even if the rhythm of the Mechanic class was temporarily broken and he had no time to set up the battlefield, he could not let his guard down. If the Mechanic class took a breather and set up the battlefield, the situation would be reversed, and all his previous efforts would be wasted.

Han Xiao's Mechanic class had just taken shape, and he already had such a troublesome ability. He was very experienced, so the speed of setting up the battlefield could not be slow. At this time, the battlefield was filled with cannon fire, and the Sunil mercenaries fell one after another. This was a spar. After the Sunil mercenaries fell, Herlous, who was waiting at the side, dragged them out of the battlefield. He had been busy since the start of the battle and had not stopped at all.

A Pugilist mercenary suddenly jumped up and drew a parabola in the air, trying to avoid the traps all over the ground and jump to Han Xiao's side.

At this time, a metal trap that he had jumped over was suddenly triggered. A bouncing mine shot into the air and exploded with a bang, exploding with a net-like blue electric current. Taking a closer look, this was a capture trap made of thin metal ropes. It was connected to a high voltage, and it covered the Pugilist mercenary in midair.

Buzz!

The man let out a blood-curdling scream as he was instantly electrocuted and charred black. He fell into another repulsive trap, and an invisible force sprayed towards the cone-shaped area above him. The man bounced up again with his head down. A few turrets turned towards him and focused their fire. The continuous barrage of bullets was like an elongated stick, pushing him out.

With a bang, he fell until he was dizzy and directly fainted.

This scene instantly dispelled the other mercenaries' thoughts of jumping up.

"You want to jump over? Not so easy." Han Xiao smiled. There were mines in the trap, and there were also bouncing traps that could detect objects in the air to prevent them from advancing in the air.

Within the range of his Mechanical Force, the machinery would receive his own bonuses. Some of the cannons were placed beside him, and their power was increased by several times. Whoever charged at the front would receive the most intense firepower. Faced with such a situation, the mercenaries spread out and charged from different directions to disperse the firepower of the cannons.

Lerden was covered in a green shield. He was blinking under the rain of bullets, but he still ran forward. In other directions, there were many mercenaries equipped with shield generators. Colorful light balls passed through the cannon fodder and traps and approached quickly.

Han Xiao curled his finger, and another wave of compressed orbs flew out and landed beside him. They expanded and turned into more than twenty beast-shaped robots. They were about the size of a medium-sized dog, completely black, and covered in armor. However, they had the streamlined body of a cheetah, like an armored black panther. There was a vertical opening on each of their shoulders, revealing three gun barrels arranged side by side. They were equipped with machine guns inside, and they had segmented scorpion-like tails that were very agile. At the end of the tails was a sharp alloy blade that flashed with electricity.

Han Xiao had prepared a total of three combos. The first was the multiple turrets' fire coverage style, which did not require any technical skills. All he had to do was shoot. The second was the trap style, which required some control. It mainly depended on whether the area of the trap could protect himself and restrict the enemy's movement. The third was the hound style.

The hound style was to control a group of small mechanical beasts to harass, harass, and kill the enemy like hounds. The reason it was called this was because the basic machine that formed this style was called a mechanical hound. This kind of blueprint was relatively easy to obtain, and Han Xiao was using an enhanced version of the mechanical beasts.

[Black Panther Combat Mechanical Beast] was a new blueprint that he had created by combining the blueprints of many low-level mechanical beasts. A 'Black Panther' had 2,700 armor points, while the basic mechanical hound only had 1,500. Its attack was also about seventy points higher, and it had more functions. Its performance was also stronger, and it had an essential self-destruct function.

"Go."

Han Xiao pursed his lips, and more than twenty mechanical black panthers dashed out. They were very fast, and the gun barrels on their shoulders opened fire. They moved between the gaps of the traps and attacked from the side of the enemy. This was the weakest spot of the enemy's defense, and it immediately slowed down the group's pace.

Once the mercenaries got close to the mechanical black panthers, the black panthers would immediately jump away and keep their distance. They would only get close to the enemy when they were ambushing.

Sometimes, three or four mechanical black panthers would form a team and attract the enemy's attention from different directions. Then, a mechanical black panther would ambush them from the back. It would jump up, and its tail would slash horizontally, leaving behind a cold glint.

The mechanical black panthers were equipped with smart chips, and four of them formed a group. They could only be used as a unit for simple tactical coordination. Han Xiao's chip manufacturing skills were still at the basic level, so the mechanical black panthers' combat ability was not independent enough. The commands they could recognize were limited, and they could only be used to harass.

Turrets, traps, and mechanical beasts — these three axes were used, and the Sunil mercenaries felt like they were wading through mud. Han Xiao observed the effects and nodded.

This system is not afraid of being ganged up on, and it can beat up Supers weaker than me. If it's against people of the same level, it can also be used to harass and drain their health. Hmm … but the damage will be very high.

Bang!

Just as he was thinking, a mechanical black panther was blown away and smashed into a turret, tilting the barrel.

In the blink of an eye, someone finally passed through the blockade. Lerden was surrounded by green light, and he finally got to his side. With a low roar, the green light in his hand turned into a knight's light spear, and he suddenly stabbed forward!

Clatter —

In the blink of an eye, the compressed orbs on his necklace expanded, and a white mechanical suit covered his body instantly!

The light spear stabbed his chest, but it could not pierce through this white mechanical suit. Han Xiao did not say anything and slapped him.

Bang!

Lerden was slapped to the ground face first, and his face hit the ground with a loud thud. He could not fight back at all.

Everyone's expression changed. They saw that Han Xiao's appearance had changed. He was wearing a white combat suit. The texture of the armor was like bone, but it was unbelievably tough. It looked more like a knight's armor made of bone. The armor was beautifully designed, and the shoulders were carved into the shape of a dragon's head. The chest armor was connected to the abdomen, and it could support more agile movements. The people present did not know if they were hallucinating, but this mechanical suit seemed to be giving off an inexplicable aura, making them feel mysterious.

[Void Dragon] Single Soldier Mechanical Suit. Compared to snake type mechanical suits such as Viper and Amphiptere, this Dragon Mechanical Suit was stronger. It was not that the technology was more advanced but that the materials used were rare. It was made from the Void Dragon bones obtained from Floating Dragon Island. It was light and tough, and it contained special energy. This mechanical suit did not have so many mechanical weapons, and it was specifically used for melee combat. Its armor value was a terrifying 30,000 points. Furthermore, the Void Dragon bones gave the mechanical suit additional equipment and skills.

Han Xiao's necklace had three compressed orbs, all of which were mechanical suits. One was Void Dragon, and the other two were Amphiptere. Whether a Mechanic was strong or not depended on the attributes and quantity of the machinery. He did not lack either; he could only do this if he was rich.

Seeing this, the other mercenaries all stopped in their tracks and smiled bitterly. "We admit defeat."

The difference in strength was too great. They had tried so hard to get close, but they realized that Han Xiao was stronger than all the machinery present. There was no way they could fight him at all. There were more than a hundred of them. They had thought that they were the ones fighting, but now, they felt like they were the ones being beaten up.

They had clearly surrounded Han Xiao, but it felt like Han Xiao had surrounded them alone.

Han Xiao smacked his lips. He was not satisfied yet. He had not tested all his weapons, and there was still a set of cannons that he had not taken out. He could only regretfully put away all his machinery.

After cleaning up the battlefield, this group of Sunil mercenaries gathered in front of Han Xiao. They had only suffered some light injuries, and their eyes were filled with respect. The strong were always respected.

Han Xiao said a few words, mostly saying that they had passed the test and that their strength was not bad. He then sent the Sunil away and told them to go on with their missions.

Returning to the base alone, Han Xiao went to the machinery modification room, pondered, and summarized his experience.

"Based on the current results, the battle plan I envisioned is basically formed. The difficulty of my Class Advancement at level 95 is a bit high, so I might be stuck at this level for a long time. This combo is very strong at this stage, so it can be used as a transition. There are also many ways to strengthen it …"

He took out these newly built mechanical weapons and looked at the attributes of the items on the interface again.

There was a variety of turrets and traps. They were all new blueprints that he had combined with various mechanical technologies, and their performance had increased by 25 to 40%.

He looked at Void Dragon's data. Amphiptere was a more well-rounded type, so he did not create another duplicate type. Void Dragon was good at close combat, and because of the rare materials, the equipment's abilities were very strong.

—

[Void Dragon]

Type: Combat Uniformed Light Mech

Grade: Purple

Equipment Requirements: LV 90, Mechanic, more than 4,000 Energy, more than 200 END

Basic Stats: Armor 30400/30400, Defense: 375, Power Level: 1,360, Energy: 9,000

Height: 191 meters

Weight: 143 pounds

Control Method: Low-level Smart Chip + Nerve Link (+ 10 DEX)

Energy Source: Portable Stabilized Nuclear Fission Mini Reactor – Automatic Recharge. Restores 120 Energy per minute. If Energy is used as fuel, Energy Consumption: 30/s, Energy Recovery: 55/s

Standby Mode Consumption: 25 Energy/min

Battle Mode Consumption: 48 Energy/min

Core Power Output: 775/1,200

Skeleton Module: TM150 Nano Biochemical Tendons. Mechanical suit's inner lining. Provides elasticity with movement. Increases damage output and physical performance. + 57 STR, + 45 DEX. Power Output: 150. Energy can be used to stimulate the tendons. Energy Consumption: 40 Energy per minute. + 33 Overall Attributes

Armor Module: Void Dragon Skeleton (Pink Rare Material). + 28000 Armor, + 320 Defense

Palm Module: Vibration Converter (Purple). Generates vibration damage. 11% of melee damage is armor piercing. Power Output: 50

Wrist Module: Wrist Strength Enhancement Ring. + 10 STR, Power Output: 30

Leg Module: Internal Booster Injection Circuit. + 8 DEX, Power Output: 30

Propulsion Module: Small Maneuvering Equipment (Purple) x12. Power Output: 240

Survival Module: Vital Signs Monitoring, Temperature Maintenance System, Oxygen Filtration, Gravity Stabilizer, Emergency Injection Device, High Pressure Resistance Device … Power Output: 150

Chip Module: Damage Detection, Analysis Database, Trajectory Prediction, Remote Control, Combat Assistance, Neuron Signal Conversion … Power Output: 110

Accessory Module: Electromagnetic Pulse Controller (Purple). Gains [Excited] status. + 7 All Attributes. Lasts for 15 minutes. Energy Consumption: 5. Power Output: 15

Accessory Module: Compressed Orb Storage and Ejection Pipe

Accessory Ability: Powerful Performance – In battle mode, more energy is allocated to the Biochemical Tendons to generate more power. + 45 STR, + 35 DEX

Side Effect: This equipment is buffed by the power of the Void. After equipping, Max HP will be reduced by 3,000.
